page.metaDescription: B2B terms of use for BCSentinel.
page.title: Terms of Use
page.lead: Terms governing business use of BCSentinel, the Business Central extension, and related services.
page.tocAria: Terms of use table of contents
page.notice: These terms apply exclusively to entrepreneurs within the meaning of section 14 of the German Civil Code. Contracts with consumers are not offered.

sections.title: 1. Provider, scope, and contracting party
paragraphs: The provider and contracting party is Daniel Wauer, business name BCSentinel, Niederwambacher Str. 6, 57614 Steimel, Germany.
These terms apply to all BCSentinel contracts unless an individual offer or separate agreement expressly provides otherwise.
Conflicting or deviating customer terms apply only where expressly accepted in text form.

sections.title: 2. Business customers only
paragraphs: The customer confirms that it contracts in the course of its trade or independent professional activity. BCSentinel is not intended for private use.
BCSentinel may request suitable company, billing, and tenant information to verify the B2B context.

sections.title: 3. Contract formation and order of precedence
paragraphs: Product information on the website is not a binding offer. A contract is formed when the Stripe checkout is completed, an order confirmation is issued, or an individual agreement is signed.
In case of conflict, the following order applies: individual agreement or offer, checkout and product description, data processing agreement, these terms.

sections.title: 4. Service description
paragraphs: BCSentinel combines a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central extension with a hosted backend, dashboard, findings, actions, reports, and product-dependent access rights.
BCSentinel analyses available data and configuration using defined checks. It does not replace legal, tax, audit, accounting, or financial advice.
BCSentinel does not automatically remediate customer data. Changes in Business Central remain under customer control.

sections.title: 5. Product and access model
items: Free scan: one-time entry with limited preview where still available for the registered context
Assessment: unlocks the already generated complete analysis for seven days; no additional scan credit
Validation: one new scan credit followed by seven days of full access to the refreshed analysis
Monthly Monitoring: full access and monitoring capabilities during the paid monthly term
Annual Monitoring: full access and monitoring capabilities during the paid annual term

sections.title: 6. Customer obligations
items: correct and complete company, billing, user, tenant, environment, and company-context information
protection of credentials, tokens, and accounts against unauthorised use
ensuring required permissions and legal bases for transmitted data
business review of findings, model assumptions, Estimated Loss, Potential Saving, and recommendations
own backups and controlled implementation of Business Central changes
prompt notice of security incidents, incorrect attribution, or unauthorised access

sections.title: 7. Usage rights and prohibited use
paragraphs: For the contract term, the customer receives a simple, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use BCSentinel for its own business purposes within the agreed scope.

Prohibited conduct includes bypassing access restrictions, unauthorised access to third-party tenants or companies, resale without agreement, removal of safeguards, abusive load testing, and reverse engineering except where mandatory law permits it.

sections.title: 8. Prices, small-business VAT exemption, and payment
paragraphs: The prices shown in Stripe checkout or an individual agreement apply. Daniel Wauer currently applies the German small-business VAT exemption under section 19 UStG; German VAT is not shown.
Payments are processed through Stripe. Amounts become due when the contract is formed or as stated in checkout.
Access may be restricted after reasonable notice in case of payment default or chargeback. Statutory rights remain unaffected.

sections.title: 9. Term, renewal, and cancellation
paragraphs: Assessment and Validation end when the relevant access window expires; unused time-limited rights do not renew automatically.

Monitoring is purchased monthly or annually. Where automatic renewal is shown in checkout, Monitoring renews for the selected billing period until cancelled through the provided cancellation method before the next period begins.
Termination for cause remains available.

sections.title: 10. Availability, maintenance, and changes
paragraphs: No specific service level or guaranteed availability is owed unless expressly agreed individually.
Planned maintenance, security measures, required updates, external-service outages, or force majeure may temporarily affect use.
BCSentinel may develop or change functions provided the essential agreed benefit is not unreasonably impaired. Material adverse changes will be communicated with reasonable notice.

sections.title: 11. Support
paragraphs: Standard support covers receipt and reasonable handling of specific technical, access, and product questions. Fixed response or resolution times apply only where separately agreed.
The customer provides necessary non-secret information such as timestamp, run ID, error message, and affected context. Passwords and complete tokens must not be submitted.

sections.title: 12. Privacy, confidentiality, and processing
paragraphs: Personal-data processing is governed by the Privacy Policy and, where applicable, a data processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR.
Both parties appropriately protect information marked or recognisable as confidential. Mandatory legal disclosure duties remain unaffected.

sections.title: 13. Analysis results and warranty
paragraphs: Health Score, Estimated Loss, Potential Saving, findings, and reports depend on supplied data, implemented checks, and documented assumptions. Completeness, absence of error, and specific business outcomes are not guaranteed.
The customer must report identifiable defects with reproducible information and allow a reasonable opportunity to remedy them.

sections.title: 14. Liability
paragraphs: Daniel Wauer has unlimited liability for intent and gross negligence, culpable injury to life, body, or health, mandatory statutory liability, and expressly assumed guarantees.

For slight negligence involving an essential contractual obligation, liability is limited to the typical foreseeable loss at contract formation. Essential obligations are those required for proper performance and on which the customer may ordinarily rely.
Liability for slight negligence is otherwise excluded. These limitations also apply for the benefit of agents and subcontractors.
An individual agreement may provide further lawful limitations.

sections.title: 15. Suspension and end of contract
paragraphs: BCSentinel may temporarily suspend access where there are concrete indications of abuse, security risk, unauthorised tenant access, or material payment default. Where possible, the customer will be informed and allowed to remedy the issue.
Usage rights end with the contract. Data is deleted or retained according to contract, privacy law, the data processing agreement, and the documented deletion concept.

sections.title: 16. Governing law and jurisdiction
paragraphs: German law applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods.

Where the customer is a merchant, legal entity under public law, or special fund under public law, the place of jurisdiction is the registered place of business of Daniel Wauer. Mandatory statutory jurisdictions remain unaffected.

sections.title: 17. Final provisions
paragraphs: Contract changes and additions require at least text form unless stricter form is required by law.
If a provision is or becomes invalid, the remaining provisions remain effective and the statutory rule applies in its place.
Where the German and English versions differ, the German version prevails.
